clue.text: Now and again getting by on a little

indicators.note: in an across clue one piece placed on another follows it

parts.note: some means a little, as in 'have some'
times means by, as in multiplying: three by four

explanation.surface: Someone scraping a living on very little money, now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' is the multiplication sign, as in two by three, which gives TIMES.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean occasionally, at irregular intervals rather than always.

clue.text: Succeeded over working motor

parts.note: S is the standard abbreviation for succeeded in genealogies

indicators.note: working here means put to work, so the letters are set in motion and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone got an engine running again after it had been overhauled.
explanation.definitionFit: A servo is a small auxiliary motor used to control a mechanism.

clue.text: House for some is one grand game

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
G is slang shorthand for a grand, a thousand
loo is an old card game

explanation.surface: A grand house for a select few, and one grand game of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: LOO here is the old card game, not the British slang for a toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: A snow dwelling serves as a home for some peoples of the Arctic.

clue.text: Change things behind cooker

parts.note: rear means behind, the back part
a range is a large kitchen stove

explanation.surface: Instructions to move the furniture around behind the stove.
explanation.definitionFit: To reorder items is to alter their positions, so moving things about is a change.

clue.text: Way of making young person see hating is bad

indicators.note: bad means the letters are spoilt, so their order is ruined and must be rebuilt

explanation.surface: A recipe for turning a person to hatred, which the clue condemns.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bad' rearranges PERSON SEE HATING; 'is' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Virgin birth, reproduction from an unfertilised egg, is one method by which some animals produce offspring.

clue.text: Intelligence about area of oyster shells

indicators.note: about means going round, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: nous is common sense or intelligence
an acre is a unit of area

explanation.surface: A note on the brainpower of oysters within their shells.
explanation.definitionFit: Nacre is mother-of-pearl, the lustrous lining of oyster shells; the adjective describes that material.

clue.text: Powerful banker embraces European blueprint for life

indicators.note: embraces means holds within, so one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: the Gnomes of Zurich is a nickname for powerful Swiss bankers

explanation.surface: A mighty financier hugging a European over a life plan.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Gnomes of Zurich' was a 1960s nickname for Swiss bankers.
explanation.definitionFit: The full set of an organism's genes is the instruction set that builds and runs it.

clue.text: Problem key set fire to central heating

parts.note: G is a musical key
lit means set fire to

explanation.surface: A fault in the boiler where a key ignited the heating.
explanation.definitionFit: A glitch is a minor malfunction or snag.

clue.text: Thanks two chaps with gifts

parts.note: ta is British informal for thanks
two men's names, Len and Ted, side by side

explanation.surface: Gratitude to a pair of fellows who brought presents.
explanation.definitionFit: Gifts here are natural abilities, so someone endowed with them is skilled.

clue.text: Magazine goes for Hitchcock film

parts.note: The Lady is a long-running British women's weekly magazine
goes in the sense of disappears

explanation.surface: A periodical departs in favour of a Hitchcock movie.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lady is a British weekly magazine, founded 1885.
explanation.definitionFit: A 1938 Alfred Hitchcock thriller about a woman who disappears on a train.

clue.text: Fundamental truth I place in member of royal family

indicators.note: in means placed inside the next piece

parts.note: a prince is a royal family member
PL is the abbreviation for place, as in street names

explanation.surface: Someone claiming a position within the royal family.
explanation.definitionFit: A principle is a basic law or proposition on which reasoning rests.

clue.text: Animal runs in circle round Henry

indicators.note: round means surrounding, so the string encloses a letter

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
O is a circle by its shape
H is the abbreviation for henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A beast charging in a ring around a man named Henry.
explanation.walkthrough: R, IN and O go round H, which sits after the R.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhinoceros is a large horned mammal.

clue.text: Out on a limb embracing this style of music

definitions.note: a noun phrase here for an adjective: music written in this manner is in a key

indicators.note: embracing means the phrase holds the letters within it

explanation.surface: A daring musical style that takes a risk.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonal music is organised around a key centre, a broad style as opposed to atonal.

clue.text: First of Ugli fruit to be gathered by a new machine

indicators.note: gathered by means taken inside, so the pieces sit within A and N
first of means the opening letter of the word Ugli

parts.note: a tomato is botanically a fruit

explanation.surface: Harvesting an ugli fruit, with a newfangled machine doing the gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: An ugli is a Jamaican citrus fruit; 'to be' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: An automaton is a self-operating machine or robot.

clue.text: Be mean towards Kipling novel after second page

indicators.note: after means the novel comes behind the second

parts.note: Kim is Rudyard Kipling's 1901 novel

explanation.surface: Being stingy in one's attitude to a Kipling book after the second page.
explanation.definitionFit: To economise excessively, giving too little, is to act stingily.

clue.text: Professional misconduct involved clear impact

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A misconduct case with an obvious effect.
explanation.definitionFit: Malpractice is improper or negligent conduct by a professional such as a doctor or lawyer.

clue.text: Yew, say, outside old church is a poetic feature

indicators.note: outside means the first word stands around the others

parts.note: a yew is an example of a tree

explanation.surface: A yew tree outside an old churchyard, the stuff of poetry.
explanation.walkthrough: The yew's old link with churchyards makes the scene; 'say' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A trochee is a metrical foot of one stressed then one unstressed syllable.

clue.text: Abandoned regimen eating last of gateau, a really sweet item

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so a letter goes inside
an abandoned diet is thrown into disorder, so the letters are rearranged
last of means the final letter of the word gateau

explanation.surface: Giving up the diet and eating the last of the cake, a sweet treat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abandoned' rearranges REGIMEN into MERINGE; 'eating' puts U inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Meringue, baked whipped egg white and sugar, is an intensely sugary confection.

clue.text: Horse among loose highland cattle will appear thus

indicators.note: among means placed in the middle of the next word

parts.note: saggy means loose, hanging slackly
horse is slang for heroin, abbreviated H

explanation.surface: A horse loose among long-haired Scottish cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Horse' is not GG here: it is drug slang for heroin, H.
explanation.definitionFit: Highland cattle have long, unkempt coats, so they look hairy and tousled.

clue.text: Queer Street resounded with the last of these

parts.note: rang means resounded, as a bell

indicators.note: the last of means the final letter of the word these

explanation.surface: An odd street echoed with the final sounds of these.
explanation.definitionFit: Queer in its older sense means odd or peculiar.

clue.text: Manage goal for England player?

definitions.meaning: to manage a business is to operate it
in cricket a batsman aims to score ..., the unit of scoring

explanation.surface: Managing a goal for an England footballer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goal' suggests football, but the England player is a cricketer, whose aim is each score.
explanation.definitionFit: To manage is to operate or direct; in cricket a single scoring unit is what a batter seeks.

clue.text: Excessive outlay unfortunately proves downfall

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things gone wrong, so the letters go awry

parts.note: end in the sense of ruin or demise

explanation.surface: Spending too much leads to ruin, a warning tale.
explanation.definitionFit: To spend beyond one's means is too large an expenditure, used here as a noun.

clue.text: Skimpy garment clothing queen gets curt treatment

parts.note: skimpy means short, scanty

indicators.note: clothing means covering, so the garment goes round the letter

parts.note: a shift is a loose dress
R is for regina, queen

explanation.surface: A scanty outfit worn by a queen earns her a brusque dismissal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Skimpy garment' looks like one item, but it splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Short shrift is brief and unsympathetic handling, an idiom from the short confession granted the condemned.

clue.text: Jerry, perhaps introducing sons in club

indicators.note: introducing means leading into, so a letter is put inside

parts.note: jerry is British slang for a chamber pot, kept by the bed overnight
S is the abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A German soldier perhaps bringing his sons to a club.
explanation.walkthrough: Jerry is not a German here but a chamber pot, British slang.
explanation.definitionFit: A late-opening entertainment venue is called a nightclub or similar.

clue.text: A bad egg eaten by favourite bird

indicators.note: eaten by means swallowed, so the pieces go inside

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
a rake is a dissolute man, a bad egg

explanation.surface: A rotten egg devoured by somebody's favourite bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A parakeet is a small long-tailed parrot.

clue.text: Left following accident in part of church

indicators.note: following means the letter comes after

parts.note: chance means accident, luck

explanation.surface: Someone left behind after a mishap in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: The chancel is the area near the altar for clergy and choir.

clue.text: Record one good hit poem that's amusing

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
I is the Roman numeral one
ram means hit, strike

explanation.surface: A recording with one good hit song that is a witty poem.
explanation.definitionFit: An epigram is a short witty poem or saying.

clue.text: My musical work, I note, generates vision problem

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work
A is a musical note

explanation.surface: A composer's work and a note causing eye trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Myopia is short-sightedness, a defect of eyesight.

clue.text: Wading bird cutting bill in feeder

indicators.note: cutting means removing the following word from the bird's name

parts.note: a spoonbill is a wading bird

explanation.surface: A wading bird slicing its bill into a bird feeder.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlery item used to put food into a mouth is a feeding implement.

clue.text: Place to stay in Pinner

indicators.note: in means the letters lie within the word Pinner

explanation.surface: Somewhere to lodge in Pinner, a London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: Pinner is a suburb of north-west London.
explanation.definitionFit: An inn is a pub offering accommodation to travellers.
